notes.title: Performance Improvements No. 2
notes.content:
Respected Players,

We want to announce that we made additional performance improvements. Please find our release notes below.

Release Notes (v1.1.0):
	- Re-compressing the whole game. New full disk size for the game is 4.1 GB
	- Improving loading process pipeline after pressing "New Game"/"Load Game"
	- FPS Increase improvements
	- Video options improvements
	- Async audio load
	- VSync lock fix
	- Additional bug fixes
	
ATTENTION: Downloading content size for this update will be +2 GB. It's not additional size on disk, just reallocating with removing some content and adding this update. Because we changed the way how we compress the game, expect every new update to have similar behavior.
	
Thank you for making this game better.

Regards,
Intetic Team

notes.title: Coming Soon
notes.content:

Our expectations for release are the first quarter of 2020. We will work hard in the next couple of months to be able to define the exact release date.

We are starting to build our community and we will provide to our community the game with quality that will make you satisfied.
